x: Mike Smithers was our other contestant further down the field. We thought we might have secured third team awards but on the final count in a low scoring race we found our 62 points placed us fourth, behind Walton A.C.
Our field events section for the day was Mike Smithers and Roy Shuter who both took second place in their events. Mike leapt 19'9" and Roy heaved the shot 40'-2".

Mick Smithers, in his first year as a Senior, has jumped 20'11" - with several over 21'0" disallowed, and Derek Wade (still a Junior) has leapt 20'8" - yet he has set his sights on breaking 2 minutes for the 'half'!
Mike Smithers, in the long jump, was also unfortunate. His 20'11½" failed to put him in the last six by just 1", and to think he had a jump of well over 21'0" disallowed - oh, well!

Outstanding Belgrave performer at this evening meeting was Mike Smithers who long jumped 21'5¾" - a mere 9¾" behind U.K. record holder John Howell (H.H.H.) Bill Kerr (9:20:0) was a comfortable winner of the 2 miles but was edged out in the mile by team-mate John Thresher (4:26:4).
…ly, we were well set to record a convincing win in our first fixture. Other winners were Bill Couzens - 150'0" Javelin, Mike Smithers - 20'1¼" Long Jump and R.…
George Edwards (Javelin, shot and high jump) and Mike Smithers (long jump and shot) were our stalwarts, as usual, in the field and gathered 26 points between them!

This let in Graham Worrall and Pat (Nanny-Goat) Cornelius and Mike Smithers to take the medals. The 'quarter' developed into a two horse race between Worrall and Pete Pepe, whose form over the hurdles has of late been so encouraging.
Smithers and Leroy had a private battle in the Long Jump with Mike just beating his less experienced rival by the odd half-inch (19'6½" to 19'6").

Worrall won the second string in 51.5 (probably 'niggled' at not being selected as No. 1.) Couzens won the Javelin (155'.1"), Kerr won the mile (4:18.1) and Mike Smithers popped up in several spots to collect valuable points.

Our congratulations are extended to Mike Smithers and Ken Miller on their recent marriages. Belgrave have been invited to compete in the 'Sward Trophy' meeting at the Polytechnic Stadium on July, 25th.
